memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel and asked the servant, 'Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?' 'He is my master,' the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself." - Gen 24:64-65 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Rebekah looks up and sees Isaac, and immediately she gets down from her camel and covers herself with a veil. In her culture, this was a gesture of modesty and respect as she came to meet her husband-to-be. There is a quiet dignity in the moment.

Both Isaac and Rebekah show us something attractive here. He was found in meditation; she responds with humility and honour. Two people who barely know each other are brought together, and both carry themselves with grace. God had prepared not only the circumstances but the characters of both.

We live in a world that often prizes boldness and self-display. Rebekah's gentle modesty is a reminder that there is real beauty in humility and respect. Honouring others, carrying ourselves with dignity, treating relationships as sacred — these things still matter deeply to God (1 Pet 3:3-4).

As this couple prepares to meet, we see the fruit of a journey soaked in prayer. God had gone ahead, arranged every detail, and brought two willing hearts together. When we walk in step with God, He is able to bring the right people and the right moments into our lives at just the right time.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I value humility and respect in how I treat others?
2. Where might quiet dignity matter more than self-display?
3. Can I trust God to bring the right people at the right time?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, grow in me a gentle, humble spirit that honours others and treats relationships as sacred. Thank You for arranging the right moments in Your perfect time. Amen.
